title: London Bridge at Lake Havasu has children walled up in it
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of London Bridge at Lake Havasu has children walled up in it, about 1960s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Knight of Columbus is the controlling interest and the reason they brought that bridge is because there's kids walled up in it

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on a podcast, repeats a claim he credits to a man named Nathan Reynolds about London Bridge, the old bridge that was moved to Lake Havasu, Arizona, in the 1960s. According to the claim, the Knights of Columbus, a Catholic men's group, held the controlling interest, and the bridge was brought over because there are children walled up inside it. It is told as a sign of dark secrets hidden by powerful groups.
